snippet.title: CALX - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The free playable demo is available now on Steam.

Begin your journey as the Seeker on the WARP-corrupted planet Syro.
This demo includes the complete tutorial and a first look at the Canyon region, where you will learn the core mechanics and begin to uncover the secrets of a fallen world.
Discover the ruins of the Quoths civilization, scan your surroundings, and find your flow within a vast atmospheric world.

Have fun and enjoy the exploration!

Play the Calx demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4369950/CALX_Demo/

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/tcZ4RrPtTm

#steamnextfest
